title: Acme Incident Management MCP
description: Stateless MCP 2026-07-28 server to query and triage operational incidents in Acme Cloud.

tools.name: get_incident
tools.title: Get Incident Summary
tools.description: Fetch concise details and current operational status for a single incident by ID.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.title: List Operational Incidents
tools.description: List operational incidents with optional filtering by lifecycle status, severity, and pagination cursor.

tools.name: create_incident
tools.title: Create Operational Incident
tools.description: Create a new operational incident record with severity tier and optional service metadata.

tools.name: update_incident_status
tools.title: Update Incident Status
tools.description: Transition an existing operational incident to a new lifecycle status with an optional triage note.

tools.name: delete_incident
tools.title: Delete Operational Incident
tools.description: Permanently delete an operational incident record by unique identifier.
